corpus.text: The current people policy grants eligible employees 16 weeks of paid parental leave from the child's arrival date.
Production API credentials must be rotated every 90 days and immediately after a suspected exposure.
The approved retention standard deletes raw customer event records after 30 days.
A superseded 2022 proposal suggested retaining raw customer event records for 365 days; it was never approved.
Expense claims must be submitted by the fifth working day of the next month.
The approved customer policy accepts refund requests within 30 calendar days of delivery.
A superseded customer refund pilot allowed a customer to request a refund within 60 calendar days after delivery, but that pilot ended and is not current policy.
The refund status notification service usually sends an email within 30 minutes.
Annual leave requests should normally be submitted 16 days before travel.

Incident handbook. Every alert is triaged by the on-call engineer, who records a severity in the incident channel. Severity-one incidents affect all customers or risk data loss and must be escalated to the incident commander within 15 minutes. Severity-two incidents affect a subset of customers and are reviewed the next working day. Post-incident reviews are blameless and are published within five working days.
The on-call rota changes every Monday at 10:00 and each engineer covers at most one week in four.

cases.query: How much paid parental leave is available?
cases.answer: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave from the child's arrival [leave-current].

cases.query: How often should production API credentials be rotated?
cases.answer: Production API credentials are rotated every 90 days and immediately after a suspected exposure [keys-current].

cases.query: How long should raw customer event records be retained?
cases.answer: Raw customer event records are deleted after 30 days [retention-current]. A 2022 proposal to keep them for 365 days was never approved [retention-superseded].

cases.query: How many days after delivery can a customer request a refund?
cases.answer: Customers can request a refund within 30 calendar days of delivery [refund-current]. The earlier 60-day pilot has ended and is not current policy [refund-superseded].
Expense claims must be submitted by the fifth working day of the following month [expenses].

cases.query: How quickly must a severity-one incident be escalated?
cases.answer: A severity-one incident must be escalated to the incident commander within 15 minutes [incident-handbook].
